name: Notepad Password Files Discovery
description: Detects the execution of Notepad to open a file that has the string "password" which may indicate unauthorized access to credentials or suspicious activity.
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: Legitimate use of opening files from remote hosts by administrators or users. However, storing passwords in text readable format could potentially be a violation of the organization's policy. Any match should be investigated further.
query: process.parent.executable:*\\explorer.exe AND process.executable:*\\notepad.exe AND (process.command_line:(*password*.txt OR *password*.csv OR *password*.doc OR *password*.xls))
